doctrine.statement: The KIE rule 12 band (95 to 100 percent of the model's live field maximum, floor 80 percent, genuine specification only) is Skill 71's native authoring target, superseding Amendment 6 Part C where they conflict.

parameters.ceiling_rule: A ceiling is enforced only when the cap status is published or owner_observed AND a numeric cap is present; under not_published no ceiling is enforced, nothing is truncated to fit an imagined limit, and length is recorded as telemetry only (S63 note item 1, from the launch_prompt_policy.py branch structure and prompt-policy.md sections 1 and 7). Settled operative band (MAIN settlement of U1, 2026-10-17): floor 5,000 characters, normal target about 9,000 characters, preferred maximum 19,000 characters, under the owner-stated hard ceiling of 32,000 characters for agnes-image-2.5-flash (owner-stated 2026-10-17) and the owner's working practice of about 19,000 characters. S63's merged code does not yet enforce the 32,000 figure; the code-side cap record still reads NOT_PUBLISHED with null caps, and recording it in the repo rides S63's future candidate version.

doctrine.padding_rule: Expansion must add genuine visual control, not fluff or repetitive padding. The compiler REJECTS padding (repeated sentences, duplicated 8-word-gram ratio > 0.08) before spend (AF-PROMPT-PADDING). (Skill 63 references/prompt-policy.md section 5.) Padding detection hard-fails (Amendment 6 Part C-rule 4): repeated n-gram blocks, untraceable boilerplate, and element sections that do not reference the image's specific subject fail at close. Prompts are authored by genuine specification only; packet doc 07 section 6 prescribes the test 'incomplete long padding fails' and doc 15 section 6 forbids adding filler to satisfy a cosmetic count.

applicability.scope_note: This entry governs prompt length doctrine and its records for image-generation prompts in Skills 71 and 63, in all contexts (launch runs and house runs alike; one governing policy, no context split, no selector). It does not govern the social-planner scoped policy at shared-utils/social_prompt_policy.json (with shared-utils/social_prompt_compiler.py), a separate scoped policy under its own authority carrying its own hard band (9,000 to 19,000, fail-closed) for the social-planner paths only; where a run is a social-planner run, the scoped policy governs under its own authority. That is a scope boundary, not a collision. Provenance of retired names: in Skill 63 v2.1.6 the governing band itself is implemented under the name legacy_house_band, and signature_launch_completeness is the superseded launch doctrine implemented alongside it (today also the default prompt_policy_id carried on every Agnes receipt). Both names are recorded here as provenance inside this entry only: neither name is a governing entry, carries applicability of its own, or can be resolved by a new run, and records naming them are historical implementation references that resolve to this, the one governing band entry (joint statement: S63 note item 10; S71 note item 10 concurring in full).

ratio_enum_sources.authority_rule: Term 2 (S71 Q8 position note, 2026-10-16) governs: the ratio set for a KIE-selected launch run comes from the KIE adapter's own authority record named in enum_source_ref, and the adapter governs the actual call. The Skill 74 shared snapshot carried inside Skill 71 is a cache, not an authority; where cache and adapter record disagree, the adapter governs and the disagreement fails closed by name. The N43 routing and transport mappings are not the authority record. No layer substitutes a ratio silently (Term 3), except under the one named exception that follows. NAMED EXCEPTION TO TERM 3 (Leg 3 disposition (c), recorded 2026-10-18 in rooms/S71/review-scratch/A24-LEG3-EXECUTION-2026-10-18.md): the N43 operator-approved ratio substitutions on the KIE route (5:4 to 4:3, 4:5 to 3:4, 2:1 to 16:9, 1:2 to 9:16; operator ruling 2026-09-09) are kept as an explicit named exception to Term 3. The exception is not silent: each substitution is recorded at selection and on the run's receipt (requested_ratio and generated_ratio per task) and is verified at the Skill 71 stage gate on every task; the legacy-route ratios (3:1, 1:3, 9:21) are never substituted. Every other requested ratio outside the governing enum refuses by name.
